keep_recent.description: How many of the newest rounds (one session and turn each) a rebuild leaves untouched; everything older after the last summary is condensed.

compress_at.description: A rebuild is ordered when a call's `tokens_prompt` reaches this share of the context window. Numeric strings are read as numbers.

context_window.description: The model's context window in tokens when the tap does not report `hop.context_window`. 0 = no compress trigger, the cold cache alone orders a rebuild.

summary_chars.description: The longest summary accepted, in characters. A longer answer of the summarizer is refused and the window stays as it was. Keep it well under the 64 KiB a system leaf may hold.

sidecar_max_chars.description: An earlier final answer is shown with its sidecar block when the block is at most this long, and without it otherwise (GH #871).

description.purpose: The window and the record of one model. On every call it builds the window deterministically from the ledger (the slots as the system part, sent only when a family changed; the wall after the last summary as the messages), writes the call record and its block list, and sends the call. The tap fills the record and sets the clock; a cold cache or a crossed `compress_at` starts a rebuild through `./summarizer`, at most one at a time.
description.not_in_scope: No wall writes and no episodes. No model call on the hot path: the rebuild runs on a message of its own and the call that triggered it is already gone.
description.emits_meaning: lstore: ledger operations. brain: the call, leaving the hive. clock: one timer order (`remove` of the last order, `add` of this one). summarize: the condensation request for `./summarizer`.
description.consumes_meaning: The ledger's answers to its phases (win-hashes, win, tap, rb-probe, rb-claim, rb-blocks, sum), the clock's strike (`in_cache_expired`, `in_clock_error`) and the summarizer's answer (`in_summary`).
